remarks:
Welcome to 4119 Beach Ridge Road! A truly unique opportunity situated on approximately 2 private acres in the highly desirable Starpoint School District in the Town of Pendleton. This beautifully maintained custom-built home offers the perfect blend of space, privacy, and comfort.

Featuring 2,772 square feet, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home boasts spacious living areas, an expansive living room with a gas fireplace, and a functional layout that’s ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Abundant natural light fills the home, while the large home office offers the flexibility to serve as a potential fourth bedroom.

In addition to the attached 2.5-car garage, the property features an impressive detached 22’ x 28’ garage connected to a finished, fully insulated and heated 30’ x 62’ building (approximate sizes). This exceptional space offers endless possibilities for hobbyists, collectors, contractors, recreational vehicle storage, workshop space, or a potential home-based business (subject to municipal approval).

The partially finished basement features a one-of-a-kind speakeasy-style entertaining area, along with additional flexible space perfect for a game room, home gym, media room, or your own private retreat.

Enjoy peaceful country-style living with the convenience of nearby shopping, dining, and amenities. Whether you’re looking for room to grow, space to pursue your passions, or the opportunity to operate a home-based business, this remarkable property offers endless potential. A rare opportunity you won’t want to miss!
